name: GenerateSignature
description: Creates a digital signature using a private key.
syntax: GenerateSignature( any data, any privateKey, [string algorithm] )

params.name: privateKey
params.description: Private key (PEM string or Java object)

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Signature algorithm (e.g., SHA256withRSA, SHA256withECDSA, Ed25519). Auto-detected if omitted.
